reason: I'd install the free plan because I try every new AI tool, but I keep about one in ten and paying inside a month is a stretch. An AI that clicks and fills things on my site in front of customers is a risk until I've watched it behave for a while.
objection: An AI that acts on my site could do something wrong in front of my customers, and the confirm step and logs only help after the fact. I also have no G2 or Capterra reviews to check it against.
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews on G2 or Capterra, plus a month on the free plan with no bad actions and a visible lift in the A/B report.
